description: This file defines the BuzzComment class, an entity representing comments on social media posts ('buzz') within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as id, share reference, employee reference, likes count, comment text, and timestamps. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and incorporates traits for decorator and date/time handling.

classes.name: BuzzComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a comment made on a Buzz share within the OrangeHRM system. Includes properties for the comment's ID, associated share, author employee, number of likes, comment text, and timestamps for creation and updates. Uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and traits for additional functionality.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the comment.

methods.name: getShare
methods.description: Returns the BuzzShare entity associated with this comment.

methods.name: setShare
methods.description: Associates this comment with a BuzzShare.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity who made the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who made the comment.

methods.name: getNumOfLikes
methods.description: Returns the number of likes the comment has received.

methods.name: setNumOfLikes
methods.description: Sets the number of likes for the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the comment was created in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to the current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the comment was last updated in UTC.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the updated timestamp to the current UTC time.
